Commentary.Commentary: Right! That's all from game 2. What a match this one turned out to be. Not many would've given Zimbabwe a chance after the first innings. However, they believed and turned things around amazingly well. Now, the final game of the series is set up nicely. And everyone will feel that this Zimbabwe side will give Pakistan a run for the money. That game is to be played on Sunday, 25th April 2021. Do join for the action then. For now, it is goodbye from our end. Stay safe and take care.

Brendan Taylor, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that it was a big turnaround from the first game and adds that is all he could have asked for. Taylor says he would be lying if he said they were confident. Tells they stuck though and as they knew batting was tough. Taylor says they need to do better with the bat in the Powerplay. Tells they see Pakistan as a stronger bowling unit than a batting unit and hope to put on a better score with the bat.

Luke Jongwe is named Player of the Match for his superb performance. He starts by thanking the almighty and then thanks his teammates and coach. Jongwe says that batting was getting difficult as the game went on. Adds that they decided to take pace off and that is what he did. On his celebrations, Jognwe says he tried copying Shamsi from South Africa.

Pakistani skipper Babar Azam, admits they played poor cricket as a batting group. Babar says they are struggling with the middle order but says they need to step up and hope they do it in the next game. Tells the wicket was a bit sticky but tells it is not an excuse as they should have won it.
Time for the presentation!

Ryan Burl is caught for a chat. He is all smiles and says he cannot believe what has happened. Adds cricket is a funny game. Tells they just carried on after they got the better of Fakhar and Hafeez. Tells they thought they could win it after the fall of the third wicket. Credits the fielders as he thinks it was a big turnaround from the last game. Tells they had a hard conversation about their fielding in the last game.

Earlier in the game, Pakistani bowlers kept Zimbabwe silent throughout the 20 overs of the first innings. Apart from Kamunhukamwe who took 40 balls for his 34, none of the Zimbabwe batters could enter into the 20s. While the likes of Marumani, Madhevere and Chakabva got in, they failed to play big shots and found themselves struggling against the quality Pakistani bowling. All the bowlers who bowled were superb for Pakistan. Hasnain and Aziz got two while others managed to take one and stop Zimbabwe to a low score. However, their batters failed to get over the line against some fine bowling from Zimbabwe and some poor batting tactics from Pakistan.

Zimbabwe were sensational with the ball. They were just too hot for Pakistan. What a performance from them. Not many would've even thought that they will be able to defend this score but they believed. They kept building the pressure with dots and then Pakistan choked under pressure. They went for big shots and kept throwing their wickets away. Every bowler that Taylor turned to gave him the perfect response. Jonge was the pick of the bowlers as he finished with a 4-fer. However, credit to the spinners for bowling tightly in the middle overs. Burl and Madhevere bowled amazingly well, against Pakistani batters who are known to be good players of spin. Blessing Muzarabani and Richard Ngarava too did their job nicely and they bowled very tight lines and lengths in the Powerplay. So, a sensational show with the ball from Zimbabwe.

Chasing the total, Pakistan started very slowly. The pressure was building touch and Rizwan fell. Zaman didn't last long either. Hafeez too couldn't do much and fell soon. Babar held on to his end but when his team needed him to play the big shots, he fell trying one and left the team reeling. After that, they just kept losing wickets and the pressure kept getting bigger. And they have been shot down to under 100 and have fallen well short in this chase.

WOW! What a game! What a turnaround. Not many would've given Zimbabwe a chance after they could only muster 118 batting first. The kind of batting lineup Pakistan has, looked like it would be an easy chase. But well, take a bow, Zimbabwe. What a performance. Their bowlers kept things tight and didn't allow Pakistan any momentum and they choked them in the chase!

OUT! CAUGHT! ZIMBABWE HAVE DONE IT! They have bowled out Pakistan for 99 and won their first T20I after a long time. Full around off, Arshad Iqbal swings and hits it in the air to long off. Ryan Burl there takes the catch.  ZIMBABWE WIN BY 19 RUNS!
OUT! CAUGHT! Good length ball on off, Rauf checks his shot and ends up chipping it to mid off where Brendan Taylor takes the simple catch.
Another swing and miss. This is a sealed game for Zimbabwe now. Unless there is some indiscpline sprinkled with miracle.
Slower ball outside off, Rauf swings but misses.

OUT! RUN OUT! Slower ball outside off. Usman Qadir swings but misses. Rauf wants the strike so he goes for the run. Usman is unsure. Chakabva keeps his calm and gives the ball to Jongwe who makes no mistake and whips the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Swing and a miss! Dot ball in the end. Rauf will not be on strike. A slower length ball, around off, Rauf swings hard but fails to connect.
SIX! BANG! What a blow! Is there some hope? Rauf would like to believe after this hit. A length ball, it is right in the slot.
WIDE! Slipped way outside off, Rauf swings but fails to make any connection.

OUT! RUN OUT! This might just be the final nail in the coffin here for Pakistan. The last batter, the batter who was set is out of here. Aziz in need of strike has fallen down. Good length delivery on middle and leg, Aziz hits it uppishly to the left of long on. Tarisai Musakanda gets to the ball quickly. Aziz calls for the second but it is a suicidal run. Tarisai Musakanda shows smartness as he sends the throw at the keeper's end. It is a decent throw too as it is close to the stumps. Regis Chakabva collects the ball and disturns the stumps. Danish Aziz is well short of the crease. Zimbabwe players are extatic. They know they have all but sealed this game.
20 needed in the final over. Luke Jongwe to deliver the final over of the game.
Here's Haris Rauf now.
Dot! This is worth its weight in gold. Good length ball on middle and leg, Aziz punches it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Much-needed for Pakistan. First one for Aziz, is this the turning point for Aziz? Full toss on leg, Aziz hits it over square leg. There is a lot of vacant area there as square leg is up inside the circle.  Gets a boundary!
Usman Qadir jouns Danish Aziz in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Faheem had to go for it but he does not get under it and departs. Pakistan have made a mess of this below-par chase. Full ball outside off, Faheem looks to hit it over long on but he does not get under it. He hits it to the left of long on. Burl there runs to that side and takes the catch.
Who will bowl the penultimate over of the game? Blessing Muzarabani to bowl.

Just a single off the last ball. Fantastic from Luke Jongwe. Just 6 off the over. The last ball is hit towards mid-wicket by Faheem. He keeps the strike with a single. 32 needed off the last 2 overs. Certainly Zimbabwe's game to lose now.
Length ball around off, Aziz flat bats it to long on for one. Singles won't help Pakistan.
Another play and a miss! Outside off, slightly shorter. Aziz once again looks to drag it from there to the on side but misses.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Aziz looks to hit it across the line but misses.
WIDE! Slower ball but misses hbis radar and bowls it on the wromg side of the tramline. Wided by the umpire.
Excellent fielding! Full and wide outside off, Aziz slams it to the left of sweeper cover. The fielder there dives and manages to save runs for his side.
Slower bouncer. Faheem pulls it to deep mid-wicketb for one.
38 needed in 18 balls.
Slower ball. Outfoxes Faheem as he swings but misses. Regis Chakabva fails to gather the ball. They take a bye.
Shortish ball at pace. Faheem looks to pull but misses.
On the pads, Aziz flicks it to square leg for one.
Full outside off, Aziz looks to play but misses.
Who is in at 7? Faheem Ashraf it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Asif Ali fails again and this is turning out to be a nightmare for Pakistan. They are certainly digging a hole for themselves. Slower ball bowled into the surface. Asif Ali looks to sflat bat it over mid off but the lack of pace sees him just chip it to short cover. Substitute, Donald Tiripano there makes no mistake and takes the catch.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off. Asif looks to cut but misses.
On the pads, Asif flicks it in front of mid-wicket and gets jus a run.
Pakistan in trouble. Surely! Asif Ali joins Danish Aziz in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Massive moment in this game. The Pakistan skipper is out of here. The captain who was controlling this chase departs just when he was to change gears. Short ball around off, Babar looks to slam it over point but his bottom hand comes off the bat. He ends up slicing it to the man at sweeper cover. Wesley Madhevere there makes no mistake and takes the catch.
Slower ball outside off, Aziz cuts it behind point for one.
Length ball on off. It is a straight ball. Babar knocks it to wide long on for one.
WIDE! Wide outside off. Too wide though as Aziz leaves this one as it i on the wrong side of the tramline.
WIDE! Wide outside off. Too wide though as Aziz leaves this one as it i on the wrong side of the tramline.
Slower shortish balll. Aziz pulls it to deep mid-wicket. They call for two straightaway and get it. Good running.
Bowling change! Luke Jongwe is back for his 2nd over.
Short and wide outside off, Danish cuts it to sweeper cover. Only a run. 47 needed in final 5.
On middle, Babar looks to slog this one on the leg side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to short fine leg. A single taken.
Loopy ball outside off, pushed to long off for one.
WIDE! Floated outside off, spinning further away. Danish lets it be. Wided.
Full and just around off, Babar stroks it to long off and takes one.
Fired outside off, Danish looks to cut but gets an inside edge. The keeper fumbles and they sneak a run.
Fired outside off, Danish looks to cut but gets an inside edge. The keeper fumbles and they sneak a run.
Single to end the 14th over. Another tight over. Flat and around middle, Danish nudges this to the on side and keeps the strike for the next over. Burl finishes with 4-0-21-2.
Short and wide outside off, Babar cuts it to deep point for one.
Tossed up and outside off, hit hard but down to long off. Only a single.
On off, driven to long on for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Babar cuts but cannot get it past point.
Looped up and outside off, driven to long off for one.
Single to end the over. Flat and around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for one. 58 needed in 7 overs.
Full and outside off, this one is poked to point.
Tossed up and around off, played back to the bowler.
Shortish and around middle, Babar tucks it on the leg side for one.
On middle, this one is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Slipped down the leg side. Aziz looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Big appeal but turned down! Flat and around middle, it lands and skids in. Aziz looks to keep it out but misses to get hit on the pad. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Floated full and around off, Danish flicks it to deep mid-wicket to open his account.
The new man in is Danish Aziz!

OUT! CAUGHT! Burl has another one. Hafeez is the man who departs. Pakistan will feel the heat now. Tossed up and around middle, Hafeez dances down the track and looks to clear long on. Fails to get to the pitch and ends up giving a simple catch to Maskakadza.
Dragged short, just outside off. Babar pulls but finds long on. Only a single again.
Full and around off, pushed wide of the man at cover. One more easy single.
Flat and around middle, Babar tucks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shortish and just outside off, punched wide of diving point fielder. A single taken.
Two to end the over! Short ball around off, Babar pulls it wide of long on and takes two.
Shortish and around middle, Hafeez punches it to long on for one. 50 up for Pakistan.
Flat and around middle, worked on the leg side for nothing.
Tossed up aroun off, driven to long off for one.
Appeal for LBW but turned down! Full and on middle and leg, Babar looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball goes on the off side. An appeal but turned down. Maybe some bat.
FOUR! Cut away! Poor ball to begin the over! Short and wide outside off. Babars cuts it through backward point and finds the fence.
Around off, Azam strokes it to the off side and keeps the strike. Pakistan are 44/2 at the halfway stage. They need another 75 runs in the last 10 overs.
Tossed up on off, Hafeez nudges it to long off and gets another single.
WIDE! Flighted outside off. Too far outside off., Hafeez leaves it alone. Wided by the umpire.
Short on off, Azam tucks it to the leg side and rotates.
The Professor is off the mark. Floated on middle, Hafeez milks it to long on for one.
Flighted on off, Hafeez pushes it to cover.
Short and wide outside off, Babar punches it to cover for one.
Appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unimpressed. Hafeez is shocked and gestures Chakabva what are you appealing for. Flat and quick outside off. Hafeez looks to cut but misses.
Short and straight around off. The Pakistan skipper knocks it to long on and gets the first run of the over.
Flighted on off, Babar pushes it to cover.
Short outside off. Babar chops it onto his crease.
Floated on off, Babar pushes it to cover.
Darted on the pads. Babar looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad.
Bowling change! Wellington Masakadza is on now.
Short outside off. Hafeez places it but straight to point. 8 off Burl's first but also the wicket of Fakhar Zaman.
Who is in at no. 4? It is veteran Mohammad Hafeez.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fakhar fails and Zimbabwe get another one. Floated outside off, Fakhar has to stretch out a bit to reach that. He looks to whack it downtown but mistimes it and hits it to the right of long on. Tarisai Musakanda there makes no mistake and takes the catch.
Flatter around off, Fakhar taps it to point and looks for a run but Babar quickly says no.
On the pads, Babar works it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Floated on off, Azam keeps it out.
FOUR! Another classic Babar Azam shot! He looks in the mood! Flighted outside off, Babar drives it through point and gets another boundary.
Floated on off, Zaman pushes it to cover.
Again a little miscommunication! Short outside off, Zaman cuts it to point. Babar comes out for a run bu8t is again sent back.
Short, outside off. Fakhar punches it to cover.
On the pads, Babar turns it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Superbly played! Short and turning in from outside off. Babar gets on his back foot and cuts it against the spin through point for a boundary.
Flighted on off. Fakhar turns it towards mid-wicket for one.
Change in bowling. Wesley Madhevere to bowl now.
On off, Babar keeps it out.

NOT OUT! Direct hit would have seen the end of Babar! Length ball on the pads, Babr turns it to the leg side and looks for a run. Madhevere dives to his left and makes a brilliant stop. Babar comes down for a run but he is sent back. Wesley Madhevere sends a low throw to the keeper. Regis Chakabva does well to collect and disturb the stumps but Babar is back in.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Looks like Babar is safe.
FOUR! Classic Babar! Wide outside off, Babar pounces on the width and slams his punch through covers for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Babar blocks it.
Fakhar is up and running straightaway! On the pads, Fakhar turns it to the on side for one.
Fakhar Zaman is in at no.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! The hero from the last game departs and just what Zimbabwe needed. An early wicket is what the doctor prescribed and they have got just that. Luke Jongwe strikes in the very first ball of his game. Good length delivery around off, the ball sticks onto the surface. Rizwan checks his drive as the ball come slower than he anticipated. Rizwan ends up chipping it straight to the right of short cover. Tarisai Musakanda makes no mistake and takes a simple catch.
Bowling change! Luke Jongwe is on now.
Fullish and around off, Azam gets behind the ball to block. Just 4 off the 5th over.
Length ball around off, pushed to mid on by Babar.

Confusion but safe! Length ball around off, Babat plays it to the right side of the bowler. He thinks for the single and takes off. Rizwan is rooted to his crease as he is watching if the ball will go past the bowler. As it goes past, Rizwan starts to go but Babar sees that mid on is quick to the ball, he sends him back.
FOUR! Babar finnaly finds the fence. Short ball, wide outside off. Babar slaps it through the covers for a boundary. That should get the Pakistani skipper going.
Fullish and around off. Babar pushes it to mid on.
Good length and around middle, tucked on the leg side for a run.
Play and a miss! Good length again and angling away again. This time it lands around off. Babar slashes at it but misses to get any bat. Just 2 off this over.
Shortish and angling away from outside off. Babar lets it be. He thinks this will be called wide. Not given. Babar is surprised.
Good length and around off, pushed to mid on this time.
Wide outside off, this time Rizwan pushes it down to third man and takes one.
Play and a miss! Length ball angled away. Rizwan looks to cut without moving his feet. Misses to connect.
Back of a length ball on middle, Babar mistimes the pull wide of mid on. Single taken.
Dot to end! It is another good over from Muzarabani. The last ball is on a length and around off. Rizwan gets forward and blocks.
Short again and just around off, Babar taps it to third man and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and outside off, chopped on the off side for one.

Good work at third man! Full and wide outside off, Babar once again goes for the uppish drive. Gets a thick outside edge. The ball is racing to the fence but the third man fielder dives to his left and makes a fine stop.
Full and on middle, flicked down to deep square leg for an easy single.
Absolute ripper from Muzarabani. Shortish in length and angled in from outside off. Rizwan stays back in his crease and has a tentative push at it, only to get beaten.
Short and wide again, Rizwan pushes it between short third man and point. Third man gets to his right and keeps it down to one. 7 off the over.
Length ball just outside off, pushed towards short third man for nothing.
Azam is off the mark too! Fullish and outside off, Babar looks to loft it over the off side but the ball goes to third man off the outside edge.
Short and wide outside off, it is poked to third man for one.
Back of a length and around off, pushed towards the cover region.
FOUR! Cut away! Poor ball from Richard to begin the spell. Short and wide outside off. Rizwan cuts it through backward point and beats third man to his right.
Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Richard Ngarava!

Good ball to end the opening over. A tight one. This one is on a length and around middle, Babar looks to work it on the leg side but the ball moves away a touch. It takes the outer half and goes to the off side.
Back of a length and on middle, it is pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and on the body, tucked towards short fine leg.
Fuller and on middle, Rizwan flicks it wide of the man at mid on to open his account with a brace.
Shortish and around off, poked towards point. They think for the single but opt against it.
Excellent ball from Muzarabani first up. Lovely length and line. Good length ball, just outside off, it lands and then straightens. Rizwan stays back trying to defend but fails to put bat on ball.
